logline: Ronaldo climbs the stairway to 1000: he beats his penalty curse for step 987, jumps to 988 — and VAR pulls the step away; then he tries to claim Félix's winner. 13 to go.

step 987 is a penalty guarded by a ghost; flashback: last pen CLANG off the post
he scores, step 987 lights up gold: SIUUU
he leaps to 988 — the VAR robot flags offside and the step slides away; he falls back
Félix runs past and scores the 2-1 winner
close on the grab: Ronaldo holds Félix's ball 'MINE!', Félix takes it back: 'No.'
camera climbs the last 13 steps to the 1000 trophy
Ronaldo in his stance pointing to the top; question + follow card

twist: the step to 988 is pulled away by VAR mid-celebration
